messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D world strategy game for phones/tablets using real country outlines and flags.
- Start the player with $200 billion; include infantry, tanks, fighter jets, artillery, custom unit design, alliances, war, land demands, and weakening during prolonged conflicts.

## Requirements
- Real countries around the world, with real flags, relative size, and power.
- Touch-friendly phone/tablet layout.
- Allow inventing units, such as a tank with two barrels.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a simplified fictional strategy simulation over real-world geographic outlines and reference statistics.
- Label area, GDP, power, and combat outcomes as estimates or game abstractions.
- Use Natural Earth country geography and emoji flags.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a filtered Natural Earth world GeoJSON dataset at `world.geojson`.
- Created the initial game interface and layout in `index.html`, including map, country intelligence, diplomacy, force-building, design lab, dispatches, and help dialog.

### Active
- Implement `style.css` for the responsive visual design and touch-friendly layout.
- Implement `game.js` for map rendering/interaction and playable game mechanics.
- Test the game in a browser and fix any issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement `style.css` and `game.js` to connect all controls and gameplay.
2. Run the game and verify map loading, country selection, diplomacy, purchases, turn progression, and custom vehicle design.
3. Check a phone/tablet-sized viewport and capture a screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Current game UI markup; contains IDs expected by `game.js`.
- `world.geojson`: Filtered Natural Earth country outlines and country reference properties.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `world.geojson` contains 177 features and was derived from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson`.
- `index.html` references `style.css` and `game.js`, which have not yet been created.

4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, touch-friendly 2D world strategy game using real country outlines and flags, with diplomacy, conflict, army building, and custom unit design.

## Requirements
- Start with $200 billion; include infantry, tanks, fighter jets, artillery, alliances, war, land demands, and weakening during prolonged conflicts.
- Support inventing units, such as a tank with two barrels, on phones and tablets.
- Use real countries, flags, relative size, and power.

## Decisions
- Use a simplified fictional strategy simulation over real-world geographic outlines and reference statistics.
- Label area, GDP, power, and combat outcomes as estimates or game abstractions.
- Use Natural Earth country geography and emoji flags.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added filtered Natural Earth country outlines in `world.geojson`.
- Created responsive game UI in `index.html` and styling in `style.css`.
- Began `game.js` with state persistence, country data preparation, estimated area and power, and map path generation.

### Active
- Complete `game.js` gameplay, rendering, UI interactions, and event wiring.
- Test gameplay in a browser and verify a phone/tablet-sized layout.

### Blocked
- `game.js` is incomplete; the fallback USA geometry contains an invalid `IY` coordinate that must be corrected before runtime testing.

## Next Move
1. Fix the fallback USA coordinate and finish `game.js` map rendering, selection, diplomacy, purchases, turn progression, custom design, and persistence interactions.
2. Run the game and verify map loading, country selection, diplomacy, purchases, turn progression, and custom vehicle design.
3. Check a phone/tablet viewport and capture a screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Incomplete gameplay implementation; includes fallback USA geometry with invalid coordinate `IY`.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and IDs expected by `game.js`.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch-friendly layout.
- `world.geojson`: Filtered Natural Earth geography and country reference properties.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `world.geojson` contains 177 features and was derived from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson`.
- The dataset omits the United States; `game.js` currently attempts to provide a fallback outline.
